scope: Proposition 5.2 (Packing the error part) of the manuscript “Nuclear dimension and Jiang–Su stability without elementary subquotients” (preprints/Nuclear-dimension-and-Jiang-Su-stability-without-elementary-subquotients-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 291 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0a4fd7d8c4ac282e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
